main.description: Begin authorizing the caller against an org-configured MCP server via Nango. Returns a Nango Connect session token for the caller's browser to use with the Nango frontend SDK's Connect UI. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

sessionToken.description: A Nango Connect session token, to be passed to the Nango frontend SDK's openConnectUI.
